synthesis: CloseInactiveShiftsCommand sweeps open kit_shifts every 30 minutes to close shifts inactive ≥180 min, but max(scanned_at) on ~4.6B unbounded scans times out on every run, and the unguarded foreach aborts the entire command when shift #1 fails — so only kit 10224 appears in logs, masking the true scope. Round 1 (PR #309) removed the ScanTimezoneScope spatial join and shipped; the join is gone but the timeout persists. Dalton ruled: zod-owned tables OUT OF SCOPE; bound BOTH activity lookups by shift.started_at; try/catch the whole per-shift body; Log:: with closed/skipped/failed counts; command exits SUCCESS; CH sourcing = evaluate and defer. AC-3 and AC-5 are post-deploy verification, not merge gates.

scope.summary: Guard per-shift loop with try/catch; add Log:: with closed/skipped/failed counts; bound latestActivityFor (Scan max scanned_at) and latestGpsFor (CH max timestamp_utc) by shift.started_at; preserve round-1 withoutGlobalScope(ScanTimezoneScope).

proposed_changes.change: Wrap the per-shift body (latestActivityFor + close transaction + SendEndOfShiftSummary dispatch) in try/catch; log failure, increment failed count, continue. Exit SUCCESS.
proposed_changes.reason: Unguarded loop aborts the entire command on first failure; 100% failure rate, only kit 10224 visible.

proposed_changes.change: Pass shift.started_at into latestActivityFor/latestGpsFor and filter scanned_at >= since / timestamp_utc >= since. Keep withoutGlobalScope(ScanTimezoneScope).
proposed_changes.reason: Unbounded max on a 4.6B-row table times out; the lower bound enables monthly partition pruning onto existing (kit_id, scanned_at DESC) indexes. Semantics: last activity during the shift; null still falls back to started_at.

proposed_changes.change: Replace console-only $this->info() summary with Log::info('scout:close-inactive-shifts: completed', {closed, skipped, failed, duration_ms}) plus Log::warning on per-shift failure, mirroring ScoutRecordCheckIns.
proposed_changes.reason: runInBackground() sends console output nowhere; AC-2 requires a laravel.log line.

proposed_changes.change: Add pins: activity query carries scanned_at >= started_at; pre-shift scan ignored; a throwing shift is skipped while later shifts still close; summary Log:: reports failed count. Keep latest_activity_lookup_does_not_join_timezones.
proposed_changes.reason: Behavioral tests would not catch the abort or the query-shape regression.
